rules_text:
Rules summary The purpose of this game is to sort laundry into piles of identical items (eg. four baseball shirts). Working at the same time as other players, you sort your laundry to try to make 6 complete sets of 4 using the pile of laundry at the top. Click a pile to pick it up, and choose which of its cards to swap with those in the middle: your pile must have four cards in it before you put it down again. When a pile has four matching items, it will turn face up and you can't access it anymore. First player to complete all 6 of their piles wins the game. Have fun sorting laundry!

community_text:
[Rating: 2/10] No, no and no. This is a reskin of James Bond (and known by many other names for scores of years) that can be played with regular decks of cards. The claim to fame is they "figured out a way to make it for up to eight players". Here's the thing, buy four decks of playing cards at Goodwill and do the same thing. Instead of collecting four 5's, match up the numbers and the suits. Now you have enough cards to make 52 sets! Three more than what they include in the box!

[Rating: 3/10] Para un juego en tiempo real, que se juega mejor, tengo el Feria de Pulgas de Titirilquen (The Pit).   Por lo demás, no veo nada muy interesante al concepto. Con más jugadores lo imagino algo más divertido, pero también caótico. Dependerá también de los jugadores.

[Rating: 3/10] It's the recent folk game [thing=158449][/thing] with pictures of laundry items instead of poker card ranks, and enough extra cards to support larger player counts.

[Rating: 4/10] The same game as Boom Boom  from 2013 (bgg id = 148814) A decent real-time game that with almost always overstays its welcome despite short playtime. On top of that, more than once the game stuck with players waiting for someone to get rid of their set, with others being in mirrored situation.

[Rating: 4/10] Real time card game. Collect sets of four by trading cards from the table. Some items look very much alike. 50 sets is enough for eight players. Reimplements traditional playing cards game.

[Rating: 4/10] It’s like a game of Pit, but with 6 hands of 4 cards. You’re trying to be the first to have each hand have 4 identical items. So, pick up a hand, swap any cards you like with cards in the common pool, put it down, pick up another hand, repeat. Remember what’s in each hand so if an item it wants appears in the pool, you can quickly pick it up and do the swap. The problem (same as with Pit) is if you have two people have a pair of something and they refuse to give it up in the hope someone else will give it up first. You knock each other out. The other problem is per the title - it’s real-time. 

[Rating: 5/10] 2024.  Rating based on feedback forms from Play To Win players at Drgaonflight GameCon 44.
